d:
Maharashtr ke jalganv ke rahne vale 28 sal ke bhushan thakre ne ‘kaun banega karorapti’ men ek karor rupye jite hain. yupiessi ki taiyari kar rahe bhushan ke pita mazduri karte hain aur man kaee svasthy samasyaon se jujhti rahi hain. bhushan ne 2016 men pahli bar KBC ke lie rajistreshan karaya tha. karib das sal bad unka yah sapna pura huaa. dekhie bibisi nyuz hindi ke sath unki khas batchit.
Vidiyo: guraprit kaur
Editing: sumit vaid
